### Read Seurat and ArchR object for plotting. 
#### Critical: change the directory to your working dir accordingly!
```{r include = TRUE}
RDSdir <- "/media/zeemeeuw/TAI-seq3/TAI-Rmd/TAI-seq/mmTAI/RNA/" # output RDS file dir
ATACdir <- "/media/zeemeeuw/TAI-seq3/TAI-Rmd/TAI-seq/mmTAI/ATAC/overlapped_harmony/" # ATAC root dir
seu <- readRDS(paste0(RDSdir, "lm_merged_overlapped_harmony.rds"))
proj <- loadArchRProject(ATACdir)
```

### ATAC/RNA UMAP
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}

data <- read_tsv('source_fig_S6b.tsv')
ggplot(data, aes(x = UMAP_1_ATAC, y = UMAP_2_ATAC, color = cell_module))  +
  geom_point(size = 0.1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mmjoint_colors) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  coord_fixed((max(data$UMAP_1_ATAC) - min(data$UMAP_1_ATAC)) / (max(data$UMAP_2_ATAC) - min(data$UMAP_2_ATAC)))

ggplot(data, aes(x = UMAP_1_RNA, y = UMAP_2_RNA, color = cell_module))  +
  geom_point(size = 0.1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mmjoint_colors) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  coord_fixed((max(data$UMAP_1_RNA) - min(data$UMAP_1_RNA)) / (max(data$UMAP_2_RNA) - min(data$UMAP_2_RNA)))



```

### TF variance
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
n_label <- 20
plotVarDev <- getVarDeviations(proj, name = "MotifMatrix", plot = FALSE, n = n_label)
plotVarDev <- data.frame(plotVarDev)
ggplot(plotVarDev, aes(x = rank, y = combinedVars)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  geom_point(aes(color = combinedVars), size = 1) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = plotVarDev[rev(seq_len(n_label)), 
  ], aes(x = rank, y = combinedVars, label = name), 
  size = 1.5, color = "black", nudge_x = 2, max.overlaps = 2000) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = choose_colorset("comet"))
  
```
